## Before you start

Continue in the same R session with `export_context` and `open_observe_api()` from article 01.
[See the Public API setup](01_prepare_export.html#public-api).

### Output directory

The run directory is dated and sits under the ROS target. This example uses `2026-11-24`.

```{r output-directory, eval=FALSE}
# Set the date used in the output directory name.
run_date <- as.Date("2026-11-24")
# Use the target directory from the export context.
run_directory <- file.path(export_context$paths$target_directory, format(run_date, "%Y-%m-%d"), "public-api")
# Create a new directory for the extracted trips.
if (!dir.create(run_directory, recursive = TRUE, mode = "0700", showWarnings = FALSE))
  stop("Choose a new output directory.", call. = FALSE)
```

## 1. Select trip IDs

The query selects trips that overlap the requested period, including both dates.
Use observation programme `topiaId` values if you need a programme filter.

```{r select-trip-ids, eval=FALSE}
# Set the inclusive selection period.
trip_window_start <- as.Date("2025-06-09")
trip_window_end <- as.Date("2025-06-22")
# Select the observation programme by its topiaId.
observation_programme_ids <- "fr.ird.referential.ll.common.Program#1239832686139#0.1"
# Create the directory for the selection CSVs.
trip_selection_directory <- file.path(run_directory, "01-trip-selection")
dir.create(trip_selection_directory, mode = "0700")

# Select the matching trip IDs and close the API session.
trip_ids <- ros.form.observe::observe_public_api_with_connection(
  open_observe_api, function(api_connection) {
    # Apply the date and programme filters through the public API.
    ros.form.observe::observe_public_api_select_trip_ids(
      api_connection, trip_window_start, trip_window_end, observation_programme_ids
    )
  }
)
# Save the trip IDs returned by the public API.
utils::write.csv(
  data.frame(trip_id = trip_ids),
  file.path(trip_selection_directory, "selected-trip-ids.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## 2. Extract and load the source tables

For each selected trip, write its CSVs to `<topiaId>/` and save the typed tables beside it as `<topiaId>.Rds`.

```{r extract-trip, eval=FALSE}
# Create the parent directory for the extracted trips.
source_tables_directory <- file.path(run_directory, "02-source-tables")
dir.create(source_tables_directory, mode = "0700")

# Extract and load each selected trip, then close the API session.
ros.form.observe::observe_public_api_with_connection(
  open_observe_api, function(api_connection) {
    for (trip_id in trip_ids) {
      # Extract this trip and keep the returned CSV directory.
      trip_csv_directory <- ros.form.observe::observe_public_api_extract_trip_csv(
        trip_id, api_connection, source_tables_directory,
        export_context = export_context
      )
      # Read the trip CSVs with the form model already in the context.
      observe_trip_tables <- form.tools::read_form_csv_tables(
        export_context$observe_form_model, trip_csv_directory
      )
      # Save the loaded tables beside the CSV directory.
      saveRDS(observe_trip_tables, paste0(trip_csv_directory, ".Rds"))
    }
  }
)
```

Use `readRDS()` to reopen a saved trip.
